sharedRules.name: KTHORLAQ'S HONOUR (1)
sharedRules.description: This ability may be used any time a SALAMANDER model fails a Fallback Check. The model automatically passes the test. It may be used more than once in a Round.

sharedRules.name: FLAMES OF KTHORLAQ (1)
sharedRules.description: Select a SALAMANDER model in the warband. The model gains Bloodlust and Smash until the end of the current Round.

sharedRules.name: Spell - Shimmer
sharedRules.description: Enemy models targeting friendly models that are within 9” of the caster suffer a -1 modifier to hit with all attacks. This lasts until the end of the Round. Place a spell effect marker on the casting model as a reminder.

sharedRules.name: FIERY BREATH (1)
sharedRules.description: Use this ability when the model makes a Shoot action with Firebolt before any dice are rolled. The Firebolt loses the Piercing (1) rule but gains Breath instead for the attack.

sharedRules.name: GUN SMOKE (2)
sharedRules.description: Use this ability when a model attacks with a pistol, regardless of whether the attack hits. The model gains the Stealthy and Dodge special rules until the end of the Round.

sharedRules.name: Blazing Brands
sharedRules.description: While Firebrand is part of the same warband, this model has the Stubborn special rule.

sharedRules.name: RAPID FIRE (2)
sharedRules.description: Use this ability when this model is about to perform a ranged attack, before dice are rolled. The model may shoot twice at two different targets that are within 3” of each other following the normal targeting rules. This cannot be as part of a Group or Fatigue Action.

sharedRules.name: Riposte
sharedRules.description: When this model is the target of a Melee attack and all the attacker’s dice miss, this model may make a Retaliation for free. No Activated or Fatigued counter is placed on this model after a Riposte.

sharedRules.name: Fancy Swordplay
sharedRules.description: Melee attacks against this model are made with a -1 modifier to the attackers Me stat.

sharedRules.name: Salamander Legend
sharedRules.description: When taken in a Salamander warband, Firebrand is not considered a Mercenary. She does count as being at Rank 5 to match her legendary status however.

sharedRules.name: Weapon - Two-handed Weapon
sharedRules.description: The model gains Crushing Strength (1), but increases its Armor by 1 (i.e 5+ becomes 6+).

sharedRules.name: INNER FIRE (2)
sharedRules.description: Use this ability when the model activates. The Mage-Priest’s Ar decreases by 2 until the end of the Round (i.e. 6+ becomes 4+) to a maximum of 3+.

sharedRules.name: Attack - Elemental Fire
sharedRules.description: This model may make a Ranged attack with a Shoot action using Elemental Fire. Range 9”, 3D8, Breath. The attack always hits on a 5+ regardless of any modifiers.

sharedRules.name: NATURE'S INFERNO (2)
sharedRules.description: Use this ability when this model makes a Ranged Attack with Elemental Fire before any dice are rolled. The attack has Piercing (1).

sharedRules.name: ORDEAL OF FIRE (2)
sharedRules.description:
Use this ability during the model’s activation, before or after an action, even if it is Engaged or Knocked-down. Friendly Salamanders (including the Veteran itself) and Fire Elementals are immune to the effects of this attack. All other models
within 2” take 2 automatic hits with Piercing (1). Make Armour rolls as normal. This ability can be used once per game.
